identity_reconciliation: Fully canine anti-PD1, urothelial carcinoma, Nicola Mason/Ethos coordination, and exact CASE Boulder plus VSH-North County San Marcos treating sites match the sponsor November2,2023 protocol identity. This is VGS-002, not Purdue anti-PDL1/AKS-701d, not CHECKMATE-K9 combination therapy, and not commercial antibody access. Current sponsor lists BOTH VGS-002 provider groups Ethos and BARC as Closed; historical institution invitation is retained as provenance, not current recruitment.
prior_institution_route_not_retried: Saved explicit gate; current independent sponsor evidence, not circumvention of the institutional gate.

before.title: Fully canine anti-PD-1 immunotherapy for canine urothelial carcinoma
before.status: Actively recruiting — listed on Penn Vet's current Comparative Immunotherapy clinical-trials page
before.intervention: Investigational fully canine anti-PD-1 monoclonal-antibody immunotherapy
before.notes: Pilot interventional drug study for histologically confirmed urothelial carcinoma with measurable intravesical tumor accessible for cystoscopic biopsy. Newly diagnosed and recurrent/relapsed disease are eligible, including lymph-node involvement, but pulmonary metastatic disease is excluded. Additional performance-status, organ-function, comorbidity and prior/concurrent-therapy criteria require study-team prescreening.
